response.sql:
WITH station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  sa.observstation,
  sa.avg_bandwidth,
  sa.avg_bandwidth - oa.overall_avg AS difference
FROM station_avgs sa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE sa.avg_bandwidth > oa.overall_avg
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN sa.avg_bandwidth - oa.overall_avg IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  sa.avg_bandwidth - oa.overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in bandusagepct are excluded from AVG() calculations for both per-station and overall averages (standard SQL behavior).
The overall average bandwidth usage is computed from all non-NULL bandusagepct values across all telescopes in the database before filtering by station.
